native_map.title: Map and directions
native_map.privacy: Load the native Baidu map only if you agree to its privacy prompt. Baidu may use the network and device information. Once loaded, your trip places are looked up by name in Baidu so they can be named on the map. Location is requested only when you tap Locate me and approve the system permission. Search words and the two ends of a route are sent to Baidu.
native_map.placeholder: The map appears here after you load it, with your trip places named on it.
native_map.paused: Map display is paused while covered or outside the visible page.
native_map.verify: Places are located by a Baidu name search and shown under the name Baidu returned. Check that it is the place you mean before you set off.
native_map.walk_note: In the app you get a walking route and directions derived from the shape of that route, without street names or voice guidance. For driving, public transport or voice navigation, open Baidu Maps.
native_map.origin_hint: Start: tap Locate me to set off from where you are, or choose Set as start on a search result.
native_map.need_map: Load the map first, then search or plan a route.
native_map.results: {n} places found for “{query}” and marked on the map. Tap one to make it the destination.
native_map.matched: Found “{name}” by name in Baidu and set it as the destination. Check its position on the map.
native_map.no_results: Baidu found nothing for “{query}”. Try a fuller name or an address.
native_map.search_failed: The search did not finish. Check the connection and try again.
native_map.search_unavailable: This version of the app has no in-app search. You can look the place up in Baidu Maps.
native_map.marks_done: {n} trip places are named on the map.
native_map.route_failed: No walking route came back. Try another place, or look in Baidu Maps.
native_map.route_none: Baidu found no road you can walk between these two places.
native_map.route_network: The connection did not go through, so no route was worked out. Check the connection and try again.
native_map.route_far: These two places are about {dist} apart in a straight line, too far to walk. Open Baidu Maps for driving or public transport.
native_map.route_unavailable: This version of the app has no in-app routes. You can navigate in Baidu Maps.
native_map.steps_note: Directions are derived from the shape of the route. Use them alongside the line on the map.
native_map.steps_more: {n} more stretches. Keep following the line on the map.
native_map.external_hint: Opens Baidu Maps outside the app. A start and destination set here are passed along.
native_map.status_idle: Map not loaded. Tap Agree & load map to begin.
native_map.status_unavailable: This version has no native map. You can still look places up in Baidu Maps below.
native_map.status_loading: Waiting for the native map. Complete any privacy prompt; if needed, return here and retry.
native_map.status_ready: Map ready. Search for a place, or pick a destination from your trip places.
native_map.status_timeout: No map-ready response was received. This is a loading timeout, not a confirmed authentication failure. Check the connection, complete any consent prompt and retry.
native_map.status_auth: The native map reported an authentication failure. Retry later or look the place up in Baidu Maps.
native_map.status_consent: Baidu map consent has not been confirmed. Complete the native privacy prompt if you agree, then tap Retry loading map.
native_map.status_error: The native map could not be displayed. You can retry or look the place up in Baidu Maps.
native_map.status_locating: Requesting a fresh location. Approve the system permission only if you agree.
native_map.status_located: Located you and set this as the start. Location can be off; check it against your surroundings.
native_map.status_location_failed: Location failed or permission was denied. You can retry, or choose a start from the search results.
native_map.status_location_invalid: The location response has no valid, current BD-09 coordinates. It was not used.
native_map.status_location_timeout: No fresh location was received in time. You can retry, or choose a start from the search results.
